hero.description: Explore foundational enterprise frameworks with implementation pathways, technical components, evidence links, and forward-looking enhancement roadmaps.

frameworks.title: Enterprise Digital Brain
frameworks.overview: A reference framework for integrating enterprise signals, institutional memory, contextual reasoning, and execution workflows.
frameworks.problemAddressed: Fragmented knowledge systems and disconnected decisions reduce enterprise responsiveness and strategic consistency.
frameworks.architecture: Multi-layer architecture spanning ingestion, semantic memory, decision services, orchestration, and operational feedback loops.
implementation: Establish enterprise context model and taxonomy
Integrate operational data sources into memory fabric
futureEnhancements: Add scenario simulation for decision stress testing
relatedPublicationTitles: Enterprise Digital Brain An AI-Augmented System for Knowledge Organization and Cognitive Productivity

frameworks.title: Enterprise AI Governance Framework
frameworks.overview: A governance framework linking AI policy, controls, evidence, review cycles, and accountability.
frameworks.problemAddressed: AI initiatives often lack consistent policy-to-execution governance pathways and auditable control coverage.
frameworks.architecture: Control-oriented architecture connecting governance definitions, risk checkpoints, approval workflows, and audit evidence stores.
implementation: Deploy evidence collection and review workflows
futureEnhancements: Enable autonomous governance alerts and triage
relatedPublicationTitles: Enterprise AI Governance Framework™: A governance reference model connecting policy, controls, evidence, review, escalation, and lifecycle accountability

frameworks.title: Enterprise AI Control Plane
frameworks.overview: A centralized orchestration framework for activating and monitoring AI governance controls across runtime environments.
frameworks.problemAddressed: Distributed AI deployments create governance drift when controls are inconsistently enforced across platforms.
frameworks.architecture: Control-plane pattern with policy orchestration, runtime enforcement connectors, observability hooks, and escalation interfaces.
implementation: Integrate enforcement adapters with model endpoints
futureEnhancements: Introduce adaptive policy tuning based on incident patterns
relatedPublicationTitles: Enterprise AI Governance Framework™: A governance reference model connecting policy, controls, evidence, review, escalation, and lifecycle accountability

roadmap: Extend framework diagnostics for maturity assessment

frameworks.title: Enterprise Knowledge Graph
frameworks.overview: A framework for graph-based enterprise memory, relationship-aware retrieval, and context-rich decision support.
frameworks.problemAddressed: Siloed documentation and unstructured records limit contextual understanding for complex enterprise decisions.
frameworks.architecture: Graph-centric architecture with ontology services, entity relationship modeling, retrieval interfaces, and explainability layers.
roadmap: Finalize ontology standards for enterprise domains
implementation: Ingest enterprise artifacts into graph stores
Expose semantic retrieval and context APIs

frameworks.architecture: Pipeline architecture linking context ingestion, predictive services, policy checks, action orchestration, and outcome feedback.

frameworks.problemAddressed: LLM initiatives often scale without structured maturity checkpoints for reliability, governance, and observability.

implementation: Map required capabilities for target stage
relatedPublicationTitles: LLMOps Maturity Model™: A maturity model for progressing from experimental LLM use to resilient, governed, observable, and scalable operations

frameworks.title: AI Observability Framework

frameworks.problemAddressed: Limited visibility into model behavior and operational drift undermines trust and reliability in enterprise AI deployments.
frameworks.architecture: Observability stack integrating telemetry collection, quality diagnostics, incident intelligence, and governance signal routing.
roadmap: Expand drift and anomaly classification models
